      { sourceField: 'analyst-notes', hideIfEmpty: true, fullWidth: true },
    ],
    imageFields: []
  }]
};

const CONFIG_MAP = {
  'Alert': ALERT_CONFIG,
  'Phishing Email': PHISHING_CONFIG,
  'Manual': MANUAL_CONFIG
};

export default class extends CaseSummary {
  _currentSignalType = null;

  updated(changedProperties) {
    if (this.record) {
      const signalType = this.record['signal-type'].value ?? 'Alert';
      if (this._currentSignalType !== signalType) {
        this._currentSignalType = signalType;
        this.setConfig(CONFIG_MAP[signalType] ?? CONFIG_MAP['Alert'], true);
        this._dataLoaded = false;
        this._alerts = null;
      }
    }
    super.updated(changedProperties);
  }
}

layout.name: AI Analysis Worker Widget

fields.name: AI Investigation Plan
fields.description: AI-generated investigation plan (multiline text) for this signal; use to follow suggested steps during triage.

fields.name: AI Mitre Analysis
fields.description: AI-generated analysis mapping the signal to MITRE ATT&CK techniques; use for tactic and technique context.

fields.name: AI Remediation Plan
fields.description: AI-generated remediation plan with recommended response actions; use when closing or escalating the signal.

fields.name: AI Threat Analysis
fields.description: AI-generated threat analysis summary for the signal; use for severity and classification decisions.

fields.name: AI Verdict
fields.description: AI-assigned verdict for the signal; use for prioritization and to inform manual verdict. Allowed values: Unknown, Benign, Suspicious, Malicious.

fields.name: AI Verdict Analysis
fields.description: Text explanation from the AI supporting its verdict; use to validate or override the AI verdict.

fields.name: AI Verdict Confidence
fields.description: Numeric confidence score (e.g. 0–100) for the AI verdict; low values may warrant closer review.

fields.name: Alert Categories
fields.description: List of alert categories assigned by the source system; use for high-level taxonomy of the alert.

fields.name: Alert Command Line Commands
fields.description: Command-line commands associated with the alert; use for process and execution context in investigation.

fields.name: Alert Description
fields.description: Human-readable description of the alert from the source; primary narrative for what triggered the signal.

fields.name: Alert Entities
fields.description: List of entities (hosts, users, IPs) extracted from the alert; use for impact and scope assessment.

fields.name: Alert Host Criticality
fields.description: Criticality level of the host(s) involved in the alert; use for prioritization and impact.

fields.name: Alert Host Data Raw
fields.description: Raw host-related data from the alert; use for deep investigation.

fields.name: Alert Host ID
fields.description: Identifier of the host associated with the alert; use to correlate with asset and EDR data.

fields.name: Alert Name
fields.description: Name or title of the alert from the source system; short label for the signal.

fields.name: Alert Permalink
fields.description: URL or permalink to the alert in the source system; use to open the original alert for context.

fields.name: Alert Raw JSON
fields.description: Raw JSON payload of the alert; use for parsing or integration; rarely needed for high-level analysis.

fields.name: Alert Risk Score
fields.description: Numeric risk score from the alert source; use with severity and priority for triage.

fields.name: Alert Rule IDs
fields.description: List of rule IDs that fired for this alert; use for detection logic and tuning.

fields.name: Alert Rule Names
fields.description: List of rule names that fired for this alert; use for human-readable detection context.

fields.name: Alert Rules
fields.description: Text summary of alert rules; use to understand why the signal was created.

fields.name: Alert Severity
fields.description: Severity of the alert as reported by the source; use for initial triage and SLA.

fields.name: Alert Supporting Evidence
fields.description: Supporting evidence or context from the alert; use to validate or refute the signal.

fields.name: Alert UID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the alert in the source system; use for deduplication and correlation. Value format: source-specific UID.

fields.name: Alert User Data Raw
fields.description: Raw user-related data from the alert; use for user-context investigation.

fields.name: Analyst Notes
fields.description: Comments and notes from analysts during triage; primary place for human reasoning and decisions.

fields.name: Classification
fields.description: Final classification of the record; key outcome for metrics and closure. Allowed values: Unknown, False Positive, True Positive, False Negative, True Negative.

fields.name: Correlated Cases
fields.description: References to other signals correlated with this one; use for campaign or multi-signal investigation.

fields.name: Correlation Context
fields.description: Text describing why or how signals were correlated; use for context on linked records.

fields.name: Correlation Status
fields.description: Status of correlation processing; use for automation state. Allowed values: Pending, Processing, Complete.

fields.name: Correlations Found
fields.description: Whether correlations were found; use for automation and filtering. Allowed values: True, False.

fields.name: Created by
fields.description: User or group that created the signal; use for audit and ownership context.

fields.name: Current Owner
fields.description: User or group currently assigned to triage this signal; drives workload and Claim or Re-Assign actions.

fields.name: First Created
fields.description: Timestamp when the signal was first created; use for SLA and aging.

fields.name: Hash
fields.description: Hash value(s) associated with the signal (e.g. file hash); use for IOCs and threat intelligence lookup. Sample types: MD5, SHA256.

fields.name: History
fields.description: System audit history of changes to the signal; use for compliance and troubleshooting.

fields.name: Intelligence Verdict
fields.description: Verdict from threat intelligence enrichment; read-only. Allowed values: Unknown, Benign, Suspicious, Malicious.

fields.name: Knowledge Base Reference
fields.description: Reference to linked knowledge base articles; use for playbooks and documentation.

fields.name: Last Updated
fields.description: Timestamp when the signal was last updated; use for staleness and SLA.

fields.name: Last updated by
fields.description: User or group that last updated the signal; use for audit context.

fields.name: Manual Verdict
fields.description: Analyst-assigned verdict for the signal; primary human verdict for triage. Allowed values: Unknown, Benign, Suspicious, Malicious.

fields.name: MITRE ATT&CK Techniques
fields.description: List of MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs or names mapped to this signal; use for framework-based analysis and reporting.

fields.name: MITRE D3FEND Techniques
fields.description: List of MITRE D3FEND technique IDs or names; use for defensive technique context.

fields.name: Observables
fields.description: List of observables (IPs, domains, hashes, etc.) extracted from the signal; use for IOCs and threat intelligence lookup. Sample types: IP, domain, hash, email.

fields.name: Organization
fields.description: Organization name associated with the signal; use for tenancy or business context.

fields.name: Organization ID
fields.description: Organization identifier; use for multi-tenant filtering and scoping.

fields.name: Phishing Email Attachment Metadata
fields.description: Metadata for attachments in a phishing email signal; use to assess attachment-based risk.

fields.name: Phishing Email Attachments
fields.description: Attachment files from the phishing email; use as evidence for analysis and preservation.

fields.name: Phishing Email Body Image
fields.description: Rendered image of the email body; use as visual evidence for phishing assessment.

fields.name: Phishing Email CC Addresses
fields.description: List of CC addresses from the phishing email; use for sender and recipient context. Sample format: email addresses.

fields.name: Phishing Email Delivery Timestamp
fields.description: When the email was delivered; use for timeline and freshness of the signal.

fields.name: Phishing Email DKIM Check
fields.description: Result of DKIM check for the email; use for authenticity and spoofing context.

fields.name: Phishing Email DKIM Results
fields.description: Detailed DKIM results; use for technical email authentication.

fields.name: Phishing Email DMARC Check
fields.description: Result of DMARC check; use to assess legitimacy of the sender domain.

fields.name: Phishing Email DMARC Results
fields.description: Detailed DMARC results; use for technical email authentication.

fields.name: Phishing Email From
fields.description: From address of the phishing email; primary sender identity for phishing assessment.

fields.name: Phishing Email Headers
fields.description: Raw email headers; use for full technical detail in email forensics.

fields.name: Phishing Email HTML Body
fields.description: HTML body of the email; use for phishing and scam content analysis.

fields.name: Phishing Email Message ID
fields.description: Email Message-ID header; unique identifier for the message. Value format: RFC 5322 Message-ID.

fields.name: Phishing Email MIME Parts
fields.description: MIME structure of the email; use for attachments and encoding detail.

fields.name: Phishing Email MTA
fields.description: Mail transfer agent or path information; use for delivery path context.

fields.name: Phishing Email Raw
fields.description: Raw email source (e.g. EML); use for full-fidelity analysis.

fields.name: Phishing Email Reply-To Addresses
fields.description: Reply-To addresses from the email; use for sender identity context.

fields.name: Phishing Email Return Path
fields.description: Return-Path header value; use for email delivery context.

fields.name: Phishing Email Sender Domain
fields.description: Domain of the sender; use for reputation and blocklisting.

fields.name: Phishing Email Sender IP Address
fields.description: IP address of the sender or relay; use for network and geo context.

fields.name: Phishing Email SPF Check
fields.description: Result of SPF check; use for email authentication and spoofing context.

fields.name: Phishing Email SPF Results
fields.description: Detailed SPF results; use for technical email authentication.

fields.name: Phishing Email Subject
fields.description: Subject line of the phishing email; primary content summary for phishing assessment.

fields.name: Phishing Email Text Body
fields.description: Plain-text body of the email; use for content analysis and search.

fields.name: Phishing Email To Addresses
fields.description: List of To addresses of the email; use for recipient and scope context. Sample format: email addresses.

fields.name: Plan Agent Session ID
fields.description: Session ID for the AI plan agent; internal automation tracking.

fields.name: Playbook Details
fields.description: Text details from playbook execution; use for automation and run context.

fields.name: Playbook Run Data
fields.description: Stores the AI-SOC playbook execution data.

fields.name: Playbook Run Data Attachments
fields.description: Stores the AI-SOC playbook executed components inputs/outputs as attachments.

fields.name: Playbook Run ID
fields.description: Update this value using the playbook triggered by this routing rule. Use metadata to populate the run-id.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Priority level for triage; drives queue order and SLA. Allowed values: P4, P3, P2, P1, P0 (P0 highest).

fields.name: Read Only
fields.description: Flag indicating record is read-only when linked to a case; UI and automation control. Allowed value: Read Only.

fields.name: Reassign Owner
fields.description: Flag used when re-assigning owner; workflow trigger. Allowed values: True, False.

fields.name: Remediation Agent Session ID
fields.description: Session ID for the remediation AI agent; internal automation tracking.

fields.name: Requires Attention
fields.description: Whether the record requires analyst attention; use for queue and Claim behavior. Allowed values: True, False.

fields.name: Rule Details
fields.description: Details from rule engine processing; use for automation context.

fields.name: Rule Last Processed
fields.description: When the rules engine last processed this record; use for automation timestamp.

fields.name: Rule Matched
fields.description: Which rule(s) matched; use for routing and automation logic.

fields.name: Rule Processed Reference
fields.description: Reference to the rule or rule run that processed the record; use for automation linkage.

fields.name: Rule Processing Status
fields.description: Status of rule engine processing; use for automation state. Allowed values: Pending, Processing, Complete.

fields.name: Severity
fields.description: Severity of the signal, a measure of potential impact; use for triage. Allowed values: Unknown, Informational, Low, Medium, High, Critical.

fields.name: Signal Description
fields.description: Human-readable description of the signal; summary for analysts and reporting.

fields.name: Signal Impacted Assets
fields.description: List of assets (e.g. hosts) impacted by the signal; use for scope and impact assessment.

fields.name: Signal Impacted IP Addresses
fields.description: List of IP addresses impacted by the signal; use for network scope and containment. Sample format: dotted-decimal.

fields.name: Signal Impacted Users
fields.description: List of users impacted by the signal; use for identity scope and response.

fields.name: Signal Name
fields.description: Display name or title of the signal; primary label for the record.

fields.name: Signal Routing Rule
fields.description: Routing rule that directed this signal; use for assignment and tuning.

fields.name: Signal Source
fields.description: Source system or channel that produced the signal (e.g. SIEM, email); use for origin context.

fields.name: Signal Type
fields.description: Type of signal; determines which fields and workflows apply. Allowed values: Manual, Phishing Email, Alert.

fields.name: Signal UID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the signal in this application; use for linking and API. Value format: application-specific UID.

fields.name: SLA Total Hours
fields.description: Total SLA hours allowed for this signal; use for SLA widget and escalation.

fields.name: SLA Used Minutes
fields.description: Minutes already consumed toward SLA; use for SLA progress and breach.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Workflow status of the signal; primary state for triage. Allowed values: Processing, New, In Progress, Blocked, Escalated, Closed.

fields.name: Step Run Timeline
fields.description: Timeline of playbook or automation step runs; use for execution history.

fields.name: Threat Intelligence Reference
fields.description: Reference to threat intelligence record(s); use to access TI lookup results.

fields.name: Threat Intelligence Status
fields.description: Status of threat intelligence enrichment; use for automation state. Allowed values: Pending, Complete.

fields.name: Time Assigned
fields.description: When the signal was assigned to the current owner; use for ownership and SLA.

fields.name: Time Blocked
fields.description: When the case was set to Blocked; use for status timeline.

fields.name: Time Closed
fields.description: When the signal was closed; use for closure and SLA metrics.

fields.name: Time Escalated
fields.description: When the signal was escalated to a case; use for escalation timeline.

fields.name: Time of First Evidence
fields.description: Timestamp of the first evidence (e.g. alert time); use for detection latency and SLA.

fields.name: Timeline
fields.description: List of timeline events for the signal; use for chronological activity during investigation.

fields.name: Turbine Risk Score
fields.description: Risk score from Turbine or internal scoring; use with severity and priority.

fields.name: Tracking Id
fields.description: Tracking Id
